Meet Maddie

Hi, I’m Maddie

I’m a functional nutritionist (FDN-P and CHC) in San Diego, specialising in women’s hormone and digestive health. I’ve been practising for 6+ years, with 1,000+ client transformations along the way.

I’ve also spent 10 years navigating my own gut and hormone health, so I know what it’s like to hear “everything looks normal” when you feel anything but. This class is the starting point I wish I’d had.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this medical advice?

No. Normal Labs, Not-Normal You is an educational class. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything, and it isn’t a substitute for care from your healthcare provider.

Do I need lab results to join?

No. You’re welcome whether you’ve had recent labs or not. You’ll leave knowing what to ask next time.

Is this about a specific diet?

No. We’ll talk about food foundations you can adapt to your own life, without crazy diets.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-head scripts, 30 to 45 seconds each, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Normal”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s something most people are never told about the word ‘normal’ on a lab report.”

Body

“Reference ranges describe a broad population. They’re a starting point for a conversation, not the whole picture of how someone feels day to day. Knowing how they work helps you ask better questions.”

CTA

“I’m explaining it all in a free live class called Normal Labs, Not-Normal You. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera in your kitchen, on-screen text “normal” in your serif font.

Caption line: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 2 · “Connected”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your gut and your hormones talk to each other more than most people realise.”

Body

“As a functional nutritionist, I look at food, digestion, stress and sleep together instead of one piece at a time. It’s a simple idea, and it changes the questions you ask.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the basics in a free 60-minute class. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: you making a matcha, then cut to you talking to camera.

Caption line: Educational content, not medical advice.

Script 3 · “Three questions”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Before your next appointment, write these three questions down.”

Body

“One: which markers were tested? Two: which reference ranges were used? Three: what would you look at next? Good questions lead to clearer conversations with your provider.”

CTA

“I go through more of these in my free live class. Tap Sign up to join me.”

Shot: you writing the three questions in a notebook, then back to camera.

Caption line: Educational content, not medical advice.
